items.source:
The merging algorithm ensures that duplicates are removed from the
list and that locally declared factories are appended to the list of
default factories when merged.
items.translation: 合并算法确保从列表中移除重复项，并在合并时将本地声明的工厂追加到默认工厂列表中。

items.source:
Indicates that locally declared factories should replace the default
factories.
items.translation: 指示本地声明的工厂应替换默认工厂。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。

items.source: Enumeration of modes that dictate whether explicitly declared factories are merged with the default factories when @ContextCustomizerFactories is declared on a class that does not inherit factories from a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 枚举 modes，用于规定当在类上声明了 @ContextCustomizerFactories 且该类未从父类或外部类继承工厂时，显式声明的工厂是否与默认工厂合并。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source:
Indicates that locally declared factories should be merged with the
default factories.
items.translation: 指示将本地声明的工厂与默认工厂合并。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。
